name: Ontario
standard: WCAG 2.0 AA (excluding 1.2.4 live captions and 1.2.5 pre-recorded audio description)

laws.cite: Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA)
laws.summary: Ontario accessibility standards law with compliance reporting and offences.

laws.cite: O. Reg. 191/11 Integrated Accessibility Standards (IASR), s. 14
laws.summary: Designated public sector organisations and organisations with 50+ employees must make public websites and web content meet WCAG 2.0 AA.

applies_to: Government of Ontario, designated public sector organisations, and businesses and non-profits with 50 or more employees in Ontario.

deadlines.what: All public websites and web content posted after 2012-01-01 must meet WCAG 2.0 AA
Next accessibility compliance report due (public sector, and businesses with 20+ employees)

exceptions: Live captions (1.2.4) and pre-recorded audio description (1.2.5)
Where meeting the requirement is not practicable (best efforts, then alternatives on request)
requires: WCAG 2.0 AA on public websites and web content
Accessible formats and communication supports on request
mobile: not addressed — the IASR website requirement covers websites and web content; the Ontario guidance page does not mention native apps.
procurement: IASR has general procurement duties for public sector organisations (not opened here).
enforcement: Compliance orders and administrative penalties; on conviction, corporations face fines up to $100,000 per day (AODA s.37).
notes: The e-Laws pages did not render to automated fetch. The s.37 fine and the 2026-12-31 reporting deadline come from secondary search summaries.
